0022600094.text: The Atlanta Hawks (1-0, 1st in the Southeast, W1) head to the Charlotte Hornets (1-0, 3rd in the Southeast, W1) with both teams off to unbeaten starts. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot, fracture), while Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Hawks lost 1-3 to the Hornets in 2025-26, including a 110-107 defeat in Charlotte on February 11, 2026.
